Bem-vindos ao Aníbal ao Cubo 2026!

A Escola Aníbal Cesar começou a história do Cubo Mágico na cidade de itajaí, e com satisfação recebe o seu 3º campeonato oficial! 

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo.https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8

Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para novatos na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'.

A premiação extra-oficial será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada)

ATENÇÃO! Informamos que o cronograma pode ser adiantado ao longo do dia, por isso esteja no local para competir pelo menos 30 minutos antes da sua modalidade começar.

⚠️ Inscrições no local serão aceitas exclusivamente para a modalidade 3x3x3.

🇺🇸 Welcome to Aníbal ao Cubo 2026!

Aníbal Cesar School started the Rubik’s Cube scene in the city of Itajaí and is pleased to host its 3rd official competition!

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance — more information in the “Register” tab. If you have difficulties registering, see how to do it in this video: https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8

Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition.

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event.

The unofficial awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.)

ATTENTION! Please note that the schedule may be brought forward throughout the day, so make sure to be at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts.

⚠️ On-site registration will be accepted only for the 3x3x3 event.

items.information:
# Deuxième Compétition Officielle de Speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire!

L’aventure continue ! Après une première compétition en 2025, nous sommes ravis de vous accueillir pour la **deuxième compétition officielle WCA en Côte d’Ivoire**, qui aura lieu le **samedi 4 juillet** ! Que vous ayez déjà participé à une compétition ou que vous découvriez tout juste le speedcubing, cette compétition est faite pour vous.

Plusieurs épreuves officielles seront au programme : **2x2**, **3x3**, **4x4**, **5x5**, **3x3 à une main**, **Skewb** et **Pyraminx**. Vous pouvez participer à celles que vous souhaitez !

**Première compétition WCA ?** Aucun problème ! Un **tutoriel pour les débutants** sera proposé pour vous expliquer le déroulement, les règles et l’arbitrage. Pensez simplement à apporter une **pièce d’identité** pour l’inscription.

Rejoignez-nous pour continuer à faire grandir la communauté du speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire — venez résoudre, concourir et partager ce moment avec nous !

---

# Ivory Coast’s Second Official WCA Competition!

The journey continues! After a first competition in 2025, we are excited to welcome you to the **second official WCA competition in Ivory Coast**, taking place on **Saturday, July 4th**! Whether you have already competed before or are just discovering speedcubing, this competition is for you.

Several official events will be held: **2x2**, **3x3**, **4x4**, **5x5**, **3x3 One-Handed**, **Skewb**, and **Pyraminx**. Feel free to compete in any or all of them!

**First WCA competition?** No worries! A **newcomer tutorial** will be available to guide you through the competition format, rules, and judging. Just remember to bring a valid **ID** for registration.

Come and be part of the growing speedcubing community in Ivory Coast — solve, compete, and enjoy the experience together!

items.name: Philippine Fewest Moves Championship 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTczODc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--02e6d29a61b0dd2745ee55791e80dd6dccf8b9cd/image.png)

### **Welcome to the first ever Philippine FMC Championship.**

This competition will determine the **2026 Philippine National Champion** for **3x3 Fewest Moves**.

This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**.

If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look at [Philippine Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PhilippineChampionship2026).

---

# Português
•
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.
•
Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.
•
**ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças.
•
**COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico.
•
As inscrições custam R$ 25,00 (vinte e cinco reais) a serem pagos antes do campeonato. A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail).
•
Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 30,00 (trinta reais), caso haja vagas.
•
# English
•
Registration is open to any person, from any country.
•
To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge.
•
**ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.
•
**FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. 
•
Registration costs R$25.00 (twenty five Brazilian reais) to be paid in advance. Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof by e-mail, with all the information required).
•
On-site registrations will be accepted for R$30,00 (Thirty Brazilian reais), if there are still places.
